【原视频简介】
Our garden is producing more than we can handle! Join us as we tour the garden at the end of the season and walk through picking whatever is ready to harvest. Baskets FULL of peppers! What should we do with all of these?! Fall is getting closer and I am so excited for a change in pace and temps! 

This season has brought plenty of surprises, highs and lows, but ultimately learning experiences and a grateful attitude. More food than I ever expected and lots of amazing meals to come.. God is good and blessed our hard work. Hope you all had an amazing growing season too!
